simple.meaning: שְׁמַשׁ (shᵉmash) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to serve.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Daniel, beginning at Daniel 7:10. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׁמַשׁ (H8120) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שְׁמַשׁ (shᵉmash) / H8120 is traced through Daniel 7:10 with source-language evidence and verse context.
